title: BrilliA Incorporated Sponsors Celebrity Pickleball Tournament in Vietnam to Expand its Diana Brand Presence
summary: Sponsorship highlights Diana brand as pickleball participation accelerates across Southeast Asia BrilliA Incorporated (NYSE American: BRIA) (“BrilliA” or the “Company”) today announced its sponsorship of a celebrity pickleball tournament hosted at the famous Ho Tram resort in Vietnam, showcasing its Diana footwear and apparel brand while expanding its presence in one of Southeast Asia’s fastest-growing sports market. The Mr Miss Pickleball Vietnam 2026 tournament, held July 9-10, brought together competitive and recreational players from across the region and provided BrilliA with an opportunity to engage directly with Vietnam’s rapidly growing pickleball community. Pickleball continues to experience rapid growth throughout Asia, with Vietnam, Malaysia, and Singapore emerging as leading markets.
